title: Visibility fault console line calls a withheld page node or tab "a navigation entry"
body:
Filing gate: **① a user-visible defect at a named site** (`pm:queue` class). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from the os-dev reports on PR #13297 (objectui#13286) and PR #13302 (objectui#13299). This is the second report of the same finding, so it gets a card. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` lane.

## What

`packages/react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic.ts`, `GATE_KIND_COPY.withholding`, was written for the app-shell navigation `visible` gate (objectui#12700). Its consequence paragraph reads "a navigation entry whose predicate cannot be evaluated is WITHHELD". Since objectui#13286 the `page:tabs` item gate reports through it, and since objectui#13299 every page node's `visibleWhen` / `visible` / `visibleOn` gate does too. The PR #13302 run captured the line for a page node (`element:probe-13299`): an author reading the console is told a navigation entry was withheld when a block or tab was.

**Expected:** the `'withholding'` copy names what is withheld without naming the navigation surface (for example "an element whose visibility predicate cannot be evaluated is WITHHELD"), or the reporter takes the surface from its caller. The pins that assert the navigation wording are updated with it. The type docblock (`PredicateGateKind`, `'withholding'`) is updated to list all three gates.

class: a · reach: every author reading the console after a faulting page node or `page:tabs` item predicate.
